observations: Two photos show a large black plastic water tank with horizontal ribbing.
The tank has a domed top with a central spigot and two side outlets.
The tank appears used, with visible dust, dirt, and minor surface wear.
The tank is standing on a concrete or paved ground, with other similar tanks in the background.
No visible brand name or model number is readable on the tank in either photo.
The seller claims it is a 'Geepee tank 3500ltrs' for water and storage.

claims.claim: Geepee tank 3500ltrs for water and other valuable storage
claims.evidence: No brand name or model number is visible in either photo. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the images.

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water. No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The tank may not be food-grade or may have been previously used for non-food purposes.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the tank's interior or a certificate of food-grade certification.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-food-grade or potentially contaminated, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: The tank may have structural damage or cracks not visible from the exterior.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the tank's interior and all seams, especially around the spigot and outlets.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially compromised, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The tank may not hold 3500 liters as claimed.
risks.proof: A photo showing a measuring tape or known object next to the tank to verify volume.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown capacity, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Close-up of the tank's lid or base showing the brand and model.
A close-up photo of the tank's interior to check for cracks or contamination.
A photo showing a measuring tape or known object next to the tank to verify volume.
A photo of any certification or label indicating food-grade status.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
